response: Yes, treatment duration can affect outcome after radiotherapy for prostate cancer. Research has shown that prolonging the treatment duration can lead to decreased efficacy of radiotherapy, potentially resulting in lower local control rates and increased risk of recurrence. This is because cancer cells can repopulate during the treatment period, making the tumor more resistant to radiation. Hypofractionation, which involves delivering higher doses of radiation in fewer fractions, has been explored as a way to mitigate this issue and improve treatment outcomes.
